controls.name: safe-receiver-new-copied-rule-slot
controls.source:
Function Probe() As String
Dim src As Worksheet,cp As Worksheet,receiver As Worksheet
Dim f As Object,g As Object,h As Object,t As Object,s As String,i As Long
Set src=ActiveSheet
src.Name="Data"
Set f=src.Range("A1:A4").FormatConditions.AddTop10
f.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbBlue
Set g=src.Range("A1:A4").FormatConditions.AddTop10
g.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbGreen
s="source-priorities=" & f.Priority & "," & g.Priority
src.Copy After:=src
Set cp=ActiveSheet
cp.Name="Copied"
cp.Activate
Set h=cp.Range("C1").FormatConditions.AddTop10
h.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbYellow
Set receiver=ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets.Add(After:=cp)
receiver.Name="Receiver"
For i=1 To 4
Set t=receiver.Cells(i,5).FormatConditions.AddTop10
t.Borders(xlBottom).Color=Array(vbRed,vbGreen,vbBlue,vbCyan)(i-1)
Next i
receiver.Activate
s=s & ";active=" & ActiveSheet.Name & ";receiver-count=" & receiver.Cells.FormatConditions.Count
On Error GoTo Failed
s=s & ";held-h-color=" & h.Borders(xlBottom).Color
s=s & ";held-h-index=" & h.Borders(xlBottom).ColorIndex
Probe=s
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe=s & ";actual-error=" & Err.Number & ":" & Err.Description
End Function
controls.scope: Only the new copied single-child rule is read under explicit Receiver activation; no shared foreign reads or missing group/member lookup.

controls.name: fresh-reversed-geometry
controls.source:
Function Color(f As Object) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
Color=CStr(f.Borders(xlBottom).Color)
Exit Function
Failed:
Color="ERR:" & Err.Number
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim src As Worksheet,cp As Worksheet,f As Object,g As Object,h As Object,s As String
Set src=ActiveSheet
src.Name="Data"
Set f=src.Range("B1").FormatConditions.AddTop10
f.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbBlue
Set g=src.Range("A1").FormatConditions.AddTop10
g.Borders(xlBottom).Color=vbGreen
s="own-before=" & Color(f) & "," & Color(g) & ";priority=" & f.Priority & "," & g.Priority
src.Copy After:=src
Set cp=ActiveSheet
cp.Name="Copied"
src.Activate
s=s & ";own-after=" & Color(f) & "," & Color(g) & ";priority=" & f.Priority & "," & g.Priority
cp.Activate
s=s & ";copied-active-held-fg=" & Color(f) & "," & Color(g)
Probe=s
End Function
